verdict.rationale: Graphite offers merge queue and AI review functionality that surfaces issues, plus CI status checks via GitHub webhooks, but the evidence does not document a specific 'required status check' or 'blocking review' setting that enforces resolution of AI/critical findings before merge — the merge queue is about ordering/keeping branches green rather than gating on unresolved findings. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a required-check/blocking-review policy tied to AI review findings, admin controls to enforce this gate, and independent confirmation it blocks merges when findings are unresolved.
